summary: Phase 2 (Admin Billing UI) reviewed. Backend endpoints already 100% green in iter 61 (/app/test_reports/iteration_61.json). Playwright UI testing BLOCKED at login step — the RN-Web 'SIGN IN' TouchableOpacity could not be triggered via text/role/regex selectors in 3 attempts (loop-prevention threshold hit). Deep code review of /app/frontend/src/components/AdminBillingCockpit.tsx and /app/frontend/app/(app)/dealers.tsx completed and 2 concrete bugs + 3 minor UX issues surfaced. Backend Phase 1 contract is intact so once main-agent verifies UI mounts, all 5 modals should function.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 709: `setNewDealershipForm({ name:'', address:'', company_reg_no:'', vat_no:'' })` in the New-Dealership button onPress is MISSING the 3 new keys `accounts_contact_name`, `accounts_contact_phone`, `accounts_contact_email`. Result: (a) when admin re-opens the modal after a previous session, those 3 TextInputs become `undefined` -> React will emit the controlled/uncontrolled input warning and any residual value from the prior submission may leak into the next. (b) TypeScript should be complaining if strict — the state object shape drops keys. FIX: mirror the initial-state literal exactly (include the 3 accounts_contact_* keys).

The 'Load Payment' action button is rendered with `primary` variant -> style `actionBtnPrimary { backgroundColor: colors.primary, borderColor: colors.primary }` + text color `#fff`. If `colors.primary` in the light theme is the neon/lime brand accent, white text on it has WCAG AA contrast risk (< 4.5:1). Matches the main-agent's own visual flag. Suggest either forcing dark text on light-primary buttons or using a distinctly darker CTA colour.

issues: Ledger tabs row (`tabsRow`) has only `paddingBottom: 4` and no top padding — tab buttons sit almost flush against the action-button row above and against the ledger below. Recommend `paddingVertical: spacing.sm` and `marginTop: spacing.sm` for the tabs bar to match the main-agent's visual note.
Action buttons (`actionRow`) uses `gap: 8` + `flexWrap: 'wrap'` but no `rowGap`. On narrower cockpit widths the wrapped row collides with the tabs row underneath.

`MinimalModal` uses inline CSS strings like `width: 'min(520px, 92vw)' as any` and `maxHeight: '85vh' as any` — works on web only; on native these are silently ignored. Non-blocking for an admin-web-only screen but worth flagging.

action_items: Fix dealers.tsx line 709: include the 3 accounts_contact_* keys in the form-reset object so the state shape stays consistent when the modal is re-opened.
Confirm/fix Load Payment CTA contrast: either drop `primary` variant or set `actionBtnTextPrimary` to `colors.onPrimary` (which is likely `#000` for the neon brand) instead of hard-coded `#fff`.
Add vertical padding + margin around the ledger `tabsRow` for breathing room (main agent's own visual note).

RETEST UI end-to-end with Playwright once login-selector issue is worked around (e.g. add a proper `testID` on the SIGN IN button so future testing agents can click reliably). Currently the login screen's primary CTA has no data-testid, and RN-Web renders the TouchableOpacity as a `<div>` (not `<button>`), so `get_by_role('button')` and `get_by_text('SIGN IN', exact=True)` both fail to resolve.

Manually verify: (1) Deposit Request modal round-trip creates DEP-NNNNNN row, (2) Load Payment allocation to 'deposit' updates left-column balance, (3) Generate Invoice raises 'Nothing to invoice' alert when there's no billable activity, (4) Refund debits balance, (5) Statement PDF opens as application/pdf, (6) Company Details PUT persists trading_name/bank_*/vat_number, (7) New-Dealership form persists accounts_contact_* on POST /admin/dealerships and echoes back on billing-summary.

rca_of_issue:
Blocker for UI-flow verification is a missing testID on the login CTA. RCA: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx (or equivalent) renders SIGN IN inside a TouchableOpacity that has no `testID` and no `role='button'` — on RN-Web this becomes `
SIGN IN
` which Playwright's `get_by_role('button')` / `get_by_text('SIGN IN', exact=True)` cannot pin because the outer div contains other text nodes and no accessible name. Mitigation: add `testID='login-submit'` (renders as `data-testid='login-submit'` on web) OR set an `aria-role='button'` prop. This is a testability regression, not a functional bug — real users click it fine.
